text:
Emma (Sales): Sophie from Acme reached out — they want to sign our DPA + SCCs, need answers for a SIG-lite questionnaire, and want a POC next week. Key ask: what data we persist during a hosted POC and DSAR/deletion commitments. Can InfoSec/SEs jump in?
Priya (InfoSec): Thanks — quick overview: we have a standard DPA and support EU SCCs (post-2021 version). For Hosted API customers we act as processor; we can sign controller/processor clauses as needed. For regulated customers we recommend Dedicated or Private for EU residency.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): For the POC we usually spin up an isolated project and ephemeral API keys. Default telemetry/log retention is 90 days, but we can shorten that or disable non-essential logs for the POC. We do not persist raw request transcripts unless customer opts in for debugging. We can also enable request-side redaction — remove PII client-side or use our redaction hooks.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Example deletion call we can offer (team uses this internally):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/privacy/delete 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>" 
 -d '{"project_id":"acme-poc","subject_id":"user-1234"}'
```
Mark (Legal): DSAR / deletion notes: our DSAR workflow is to validate requestor, run automated search across stored artifacts, and either return data or issue deletion confirmation. Standard SLA is 30 days; we can commit to 15 days for enterprise deals on the contract. We also provide a deletion certificate for audits.
Sophie (Acme Security): If you can shorten log retention and provide a deletion cert that's huge. Also: does the SIG-lite include CAIQ sections about key management? They want BYOK details.
doc-upload-bot: Sophie uploaded: acme-sig-lite-2026.pdf
Priya (InfoSec): BYOK: available on Private and Dedicated via KMS integrations (customer-managed keys). For hosted we offer envelope encryption and integrate with select KMS providers; we can sign SOC2 + provide KMS attestation notes. For the SIG-lite we can supply a prefilled matrix + our standard evidence bundle (policy links, SOC2 report).
Emma (Sales): Pricing / POC ops question from Sophie — what’s the cost to spin Dedicated for 2 weeks? Also customer asks whether request logs are accessible by Redwood engineers during the POC.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Dedicated POC — we can offer a 2-week trial with a temporary discounted commit (usually fraction of monthly reserved). I’ll ping finance for an exact quote. On logs: by default Redwood engineers do not access production request payloads without a support ticket and joint debugging sessions; we log metadata and anonymized error traces. If the customer needs us to see full transcripts we do it under NDA and time-limited access.
Mark (Legal): We can add a contract clause: "support access only under documented support process and customer approval; access logged and time-limited". Also include audit right language and deletion cert.
Sophie (Acme Security): Great — can you add explicit SCC clause references and provide the DPA + SOC2? CIO wants that before legal signs. Also need DSAR process doc.
Priya (InfoSec): Attaching links: DPA: https://redwood.ai/legal/dpa-2025.pdf, SOC2 kit: https://redwood.ai/compliance/soc2-2025.zip, DSAR procedure: https://redwood.ai/privacy/dsar-process.md
Emma (Sales): I’ll send those over to Acme. @Ravi can you confirm log-retention change and provide the small contract language snippet for support access? I’ll loop in Finance for Dedicated POC pricing. :thumbsup:
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Confirmed — can reduce retention to 14 days for non-essential logs for the POC and disable request-body retention unless enabled. Snippet for support access: "Redwood access to Customer data during support will be limited, logged, and require Customer approval; any temporary access will be removed after troubleshooting and recorded in audit logs."
Mark (Legal): I'll draft the SCC/DPA addendum and DSAR SLA clause; will circulate as redline by EOD.
Sophie (Acme Security): Thanks everyone — if you can get the redline + evidence bundle today we can move to signatures tomorrow.
Emma (Sales): Will do. Tracking: DPA + SCC addendum, SOC2 + evidence, DSAR doc, POC pricing from Finance, retention change confirmed by SE. Back to you all — I’ll post the customer PDF once they return the signed DPA.
